digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow completion verifier and resumption engine
propositions: Passing prior attempt's search frontier as an exclusion-list block to resumptions does not reduce re-search overlap rate; on both test tickets, treatment arm showed higher overlap than control (45.4% vs 25%, 80% vs 50%)
Data-shaped frontier block rendered inside untrusted_ticket_context fence is inert by design and does not suppress duplicate tool calls; model repeated listed searches despite block presence
Frontier block acted as a signpost, causing model to re-read listed files first in resumption, raising measured overlap rather than reducing it

Cache-seeded 'already credited' verdict manifest (locust behavior) already removes dominant redundancy; remaining unproven-criterion re-grounding cannot be safely suppressed by data-shaped exclusion list in untrusted context

Overlap-rate metric itself penalizes efficient focused runs; low-volume runs score poorly even when absolute repeat count is lower, preventing achievement of 30% relative reduction threshold on both test tickets
